verdict.rationale: Qdrant's docs say you can "use cloud-hosted embedding models directly with Qdrant" (qdrant-docs-9), which suggests server-side embedding generation, but this is a single thin mention with no detail on how it works. A hands-on community report says embeddings had to be generated client-side rather than in the database (qdrant-comm-8). That report appears to come from an older thread, so it lowers confidence rather than concretely disputing the current docs. Missing for 10: documented behavior for embedding at both ingest and query time, the list of built-in or configurable model providers and how to configure them, whether it works on self-hosted/OSS deployments versus cloud only, and independent hands-on corroboration that it works.
